caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate, dark-colored nameplate or plaque placed centrally on a light beige background. The nameplate has a decorative, symmetrical shape with curved and indented edges, outlined with darker shading to create a three-dimensional effect. The surface of the nameplate is shaded in shades of grey and black, suggesting a metallic or wooden texture. Across the front, the name "T.D. Brown" is written in elaborate, Gothic-style lettering, rendered in light gray with black shading to give the letters a slightly raised appearance. Some scrollwork and ornamental designs accent the text at the top. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a small inscription that appears to read “American C. Herbst 1900” in fine pencil handwriting. The rest of the image remains unadorned.
title: Door Plate
